classification_scope: The EXPERIMENTAL label applies to this workload and runtime profile, not to any physical server.
commissioning_state_evidence: No DS4 installation is recorded in SERVER-REGISTRY.md or under servers/. No model is installed anywhere in the fleet.
purpose: Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages testing for Claude Code-style clients
OpenAI chat and responses cross-client testing
cross-runtime conformance against the HX acceptance contract

candidate_placement.basis: GPU capacity, when this workload is explicitly selected and the capacity gate passes
candidate_placement.note: Candidate placement only. This does not assign hxs-3 to DS4 and does not alter its durable role.

model_selection._comment: PHASE A. Every field is required before the capacity gate can compute residency. Arbitrary GGUF support is NOT assumed - the model must be one the installed DS4 revision explicitly supports.

capacity_gate_result._comment: PHASE B. The gate must be RERUN against the exact selected artifact. verdict_for_model must equal model_selection.identity + quantization, or the result is stale and the gate reopens.

model_acquisition._comment: PHASE C. Populated only after the capacity gate returns PASS and acquisition is separately authorized.
model_acquisition.storage_path_status: PROPOSED - no canonical HX model-storage root exists yet; see governance/operations/hxs3-workload-placement.md

ds4_runtime._comment: CLI flags must be derived from the installed revision's own --help output, never hardcoded from documentation.

documented_reference_target.source: DS4 snapshot README - download_model.sh ds4f-q2 documented for 96/128 GB RAM machines

server._comment: PHASE F. Localhost first. Network exposure is a separate later gate.
server.network_exposure_gate: PHASE K - requires local validation first, then binds the interface resolved from SERVER-REGISTRY.md

activation.note: No model download is authorized by this definition. Installation presence is not activation.

isolation.service_represents: the DS4 workload, never the host role
